scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Direct mixed-density identity, affine fixed-product reduction, global analytic inequalities and rational Taylor bounds.
scientific_integrity.reproducer: verify_or3.py checks symbolic identities and the exact witness; universal inequalities are supplied in RESULT.md.

scientific_limitations: The positive-parameter admissibility test is an exact univariate continuum of inequalities, not a closed formula for the endpoint.

The 2022 general C² independence-copula transformation paper is highly relevant; only its abstract could be accessed, so equivalence of specialized implications cannot be ruled out by full-text comparison.
No b<0, higher-dimensional extensions, or statistical inference claims.
title: Exact negative-parameter frontier and diagonal validity test for the OR3 copula
